name: nf_hackathons_columns
description: Per-column analyzer assignments for the nf-hackathons SearchIndex (syn75081639, source syn25585549). Roles: IDENTIFIER for id-like fields (Synapse entity ids, Synapse/DOI links, related-study ids — preserve punctuation, no stemming); nf_scientific_synonyms for free-text scientific/discovery fields (stemming + NF synonym expansion at search time); KEYWORD for clean categorical/facet fields (exact match, incl. list-valued facets). Every other column (name, acknowledgementStatements, wiki pointers, etag) falls through to the config defaultAnalyzer (STANDARD). Columns absent from the index are silently skipped at build time.
